examples.description: Merge-or-create AND log the call in one shot

failure_modes.recovery: Provide email and/or phone and retry.
failure_modes.when: neither email nor phone was provided (the upsert identity keys), or a field fails validation

preconditions: Identity: email is probed first, then phone — the first match wins and is MERGED (only the fields you send change).
No match creates the contact; pass source 'sync' for automated ingest so attribution stays honest.
Status moves still obey the transition machine — an upsert cannot jump lead → vip.
Same composite children as contact_create: note (a string) and/or interaction {type, summary, occurred_at?} land in the SAME call.

description: Create-or-merge a contact keyed on email-then-phone identity — the sync door the future desktop harness and ingest lanes write through. Matching probes email first, then phone; a hit MERGES only the fields you send (omitted fields keep their stored values, so a partial sync payload can never wipe a curated field), a miss creates. Status moves still obey the transition machine — an upsert cannot jump straight to vip. Accepts the same first-note/first-interaction composite children as contact_create.

interaction.description: Log the first interaction in the same call: {type, summary, occurred_at?} — occurred_at takes "YYYY-MM-DD".

note.description: Log a first note in the SAME call — ONE call makes both.

name: contact_upsert
